en: Ja'far ibn Muhammad Abu Ma'shar al-Balkhi
tr: Ca'fer b. Muhammed Ebû Ma'şer el-Belhî
ar: جعفر بن محمد أبو معشر البلخي

description.tr: İslam dünyasının en etkili astrologu || Ebû Ma'şer Hint, İran ve Yunan astronomi geleneklerini sentezledi. || [Tarih notu] Ortaçağ Avrupa'sındaki muazzam etkisine rağmen modern akademide tartışmalıdır.
description.en: Most influential astrologer of the Islamic world; his works shaped European medieval astronomy through Latin translations || Abu Ma'shar synthesized Indian, Persian, and Greek astronomical traditions into a unified system. || [Historiographical note] Despite his immense influence in medieval Europe, his reputation in modern scholarship is mixed due to the astrological nature of his work.
description.ar: أكثر المنجمين تأثيراً في العالم الإسلامي || جمع أبو معشر التقاليد الفلكية الهندية والفارسية واليونانية
